# 53ON AI Server

> Self-hosted AI manager for text, image and video on Ubuntu: an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible server that runs local models on llama.cpp and Strata, pictures and video with sound on stable-diffusion.cpp (MiniMax H3), relays cloud providers and hands out API keys, from one control panel. Built for AMD Ryzen AI Max (Strix Halo). MIT, plain Node.js, no dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/53on/53on-ai-server/blob/main/README.md): features, quick start, recommended setup for Ryzen AI Max, our llama.cpp build, Strata
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/53on/53on-ai-server/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the API, the image and video tools, the background video job, the admin API, the code map and the rules for changes
- [config.example.json](https://github.com/53on/53on-ai-server/blob/main/config.example.json): the configuration the first start copies
- [catalog.json](https://github.com/53on/53on-ai-server/blob/main/catalog.json): calibrated settings per model file
